'''Faramozan''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Ukhdari]], an [[Ayuma|Ayuman]] economy and the twelfth-largest national economy by nominal [[List of countries by GDP (nominal)|GDP]] in the world. The city hosted the [[1760 FLLA World Cup]], won by [[Verusa]] in a 2–1 final, and is the seat of the Ukhdari Arraby Association.
